title: TurboTax Return Daily Event Volume
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=turbotax:return
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(filing_status) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many TurboTax return events land each day and how many distinct filing status values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest TurboTax return records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct filing status values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much TurboTax return activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
